environment_note: This run's sandbox network allowlist is far more restrictive than prior documented runs: DNS resolution itself fails (ENOTFOUND, not just HTTP 403) for nearly every domain tested except anthropic.com, github.com, and generativelanguage.googleapis.com; youtube.com resolves but the proxy refuses the CONNECT tunnel. This blocked direct access to openai.com, google/deepmind blogs, meta/xai/mistral/deepseek blogs, all aggregators, the HN API, and every configured expert's own domain except Simon Willison (reachable only via the documented github.com blog-backup mirror). WebSearch remained the only reliable discovery channel, but its index lags 1-2 days for the most recent items as previously documented, which combined with the fetch block to produce an unusually thin day. This degradation should be investigated/flagged to the user, not treated as a quiet news day.
